widget_mechanic: When a plus-chip filter is set (e.g. '3+ bedrooms'), results include all N ≥ 3. To require EXACTLY N, agent must locate and enable the 'use exact match' toggle — usually below the plus-chip row or inside an advanced filters panel.

source_inspiration.instruction: I'm looking to buy a move-in ready small house in Little Rock, Arkansas. Ideally, it should be under $500k, have 3 bedrooms, and include a 2-car garage. Can you show me options?
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [6.4] Fine-grained grounding error: The marked coordinates fall on the left sidebar (near the Search icon) instead of inside the target text input (e.g., the Price Range Max field) where typing should occur.
